applicant_utility.summary: A rolling 6-12 month research fellowship for women scientists and engineers from OIC least-developed countries, hosted at centres of excellence elsewhere in the OIC. There is no deadline to miss because applications and nominations are open all year, but the rolling call is not a soft award: selection is by scientific merit through COMSTECH and the host institutions' joint committee. The package covers flight, accommodation and subsistence at the host, so the real work is a credible research plan and clean eligibility evidence.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Women researchers and engineers from OIC least-developed countries (largely African) holding an M.S. or PhD, or actively researching, who can commit six to twelve months at a host institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Check that your country appears on the published OIC LDC list (16 countries are named on the page)
Prepare evidence of qualifications and of either LDC citizenship or OIC research-institution employment
Complete the application form linked from the COMSTECH page
Direct any questions to the programme contact, Ms Ayesha Malik (pcayesha@comstech.org), before submitting
common_rejection_risks: Nationality not on the LDC list and no OIC research-institution employment to fall back on
A weak research plan relative to the host institution's field
Assuming the rolling call means automatic selection - merit selection still applies
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published package is airfare, accommodation, subsistence, supervision and mentoring; tuition or enrolment fees are not mentioned, and personal costs during the placement are self-funded.
document_audit: Prove either citizenship of an OIC least-developed country or employment at an OIC research institution - one or the other must be evidenced
Academic qualification certificates must match the MS/PhD requirement or an active-research claim
Use the current form link from the 2026 call on the COMSTECH page
alerts: Applications and nominations are open all year - but selection remains competitive on scientific merit
One COMSTECH programme application per calendar year, so this cannot be combined with other COMSTECH fellowships in the same year
Duration is 6-12 months, extendable only on the host institution's recommendation
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the application form linked from the COMSTECH page and submit it to the COMSTECH Secretariat contact for this programme; COMSTECH and the host institutions select jointly on merit.
